text: dsh-desktop-autostart-win 是为 DSH Web 设置页添加 Windows 登录启动开关的插件。浏览器设置页通过 Host 路由读取和修改启动状态；插件会从正在运行的桌面程序、Windows App Paths、常见安装目录和卸载记录中寻找 DeepSeek Harness。开启时创建当前用户的 Windows 启动项，关闭时移除，并显示检测到的程序路径和来源。适合希望桌面版随 Windows 登录启动、并从 DSH 设置管理此状态的用户。需要 Windows 和兼容版本的 DSH，不需要 API Key 或外部服务。

dsh-desktop-autostart-win adds a Windows sign-in switch to DSH Settings. It locates the DeepSeek Harness desktop app and creates or removes the current user’s startup entry. The page shows the detected app path. Requires Windows and compatible DSH; no API key or external service.
想让 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版在我登录 Windows 时自动打开。
有没有办法在 DSH 设置里开关 Windows 登录启动？
Windows 已经禁用了启动项，怎样重新启用桌面程序的自动启动？
dsh-desktop-autostart-win 的功能「管理 Windows 登录启动」：在 DSH 设置页打开或关闭 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版自启；开启会创建当前用户的启动项并清除任务管理器禁用标记，关闭会移除启动项。

dsh-desktop-autostart-win README · dsh-desktop-autostart-win：Windows sign-in autostart for the **DeepSeek Harness desktop app**. The plugin
adds one page to Settings — **Startup / 开机自启** — with a single switch.

| Switch | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| On | Writes `DeepSeek Harness` = `"<desktop app>.exe"` under `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run`, and clears a previous "disabled" decision from Task Manager, so Windows launches the app after you sign in. |
| Off | Deletes that value, so the app no longer starts by itself. |

dsh-desktop-autostart-win README · dsh-desktop-autostart-win：Nothing is duplicated in the plugin config: the startup entry is the only stored
state, so the page always reports what Windows will actually run.

dsh-desktop-autostart-win README · Install：Requires **DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 or newer** (0.2.x) and **Windows 10/11**. Replace
`desktop` with the profile you actually start DSH with.

This package is distributed from GitHub; there is no npm release.

dsh-desktop-autostart-win README · From GitHub：This form needs Git on the machine (DSH checks the repository with
`git ls-remote` before installing):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:nanwu98/dsh-desktop-autostart-win
```

Pin a release with `#v1.0.0`:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:nanwu98/dsh-desktop-autostart-win#v1.0.0
```

dsh-desktop-autostart-win README · From the release tarball：No Git needed:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/nanwu98/dsh-desktop-autostart-win/releases/download/v1.0.0/dsh-desktop-autostart-win-1.0.0.tgz
```

dsh-desktop-autostart-win README · From the plugin page：Open **插件 → 添加插件**, paste the repository URL or the release tarball URL
(a bare package name only works for registry packages), and install. Restart
DSH if the page asks for it; then open **设置 → 开机自启**.

dsh-desktop-autostart-win README · How the app is found：The plugin never hard-codes an install path. It tries these sources in order
and stops at the first existing executable:

dsh-desktop-autostart-win README · How the app is found：| Source | What it reads |
| --- | --- |
| Running desktop app | `process.execPath` when the Host is the desktop app itself |
| App Paths | `App Paths\DeepSeek Harness.exe` under HKCU and HKLM, 64- and 32-bit views |
| Install folders | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs`, `%ProgramFiles%`, `%ProgramFiles(x86)%` + the usual product folder names |
| Installer records | `DisplayIcon`, `InstallLocation`, `UninstallString` in the HKCU/HKLM uninstall keys |

dsh-desktop-autostart-win README · How the app is found：Only a real `.exe` is accepted, and `node.exe`, `electron.exe` and uninstallers
are rejected. The Settings page shows which source matched, so you can tell why
a path was chosen. A miss is retried on the next page load (the result is cached
for one minute).

This means the switch still works from a plain `dsh` CLI session: the desktop
app is found from the registry even though the CLI itself is `node.exe`.

dsh-desktop-autostart-win README · The startup entry：Windows has two places that decide whether a startup entry runs: the `Run` key
and Task Manager's approval record. The plugin writes the first and clears the
second, so an entry that was disabled in **Task Manager → Startup** comes back
when you turn the switch on. If the entry exists but is still disabled, the page
says so instead of pretending it is on.

Administrator rights are not required: everything is per-user (`HKCU`) and
nothing is written machine-wide.

dsh-desktop-autostart-win README · Permissions and privacy：Reads, only to find the app and report state:

- `HKCU\...\CurrentVersion\Run` and `...\Explorer\StartupApproved\Run`
- `App Paths` under HKCU/HKLM (64- and 32-bit views)
- Uninstall records under HKCU/HKLM (only the display name, icon, install
  folder, and uninstall command)

Writes, only when you use the switch:

- adds or deletes the `DeepSeek Harness` value in the per-user `Run` key
- deletes the matching `StartupApproved` value so Windows does not skip it

dsh-desktop-autostart-win README · Permissions and privacy：The plugin makes **no network requests**, writes **no files**, and collects
**no telemetry**. The detected path and registry values are returned only to the
local Settings page (the routes reject non-loopback peers and are read-only
except for the one boolean switch).

dsh-desktop-autostart-win README · Uninstall：Turn the switch off first if you no longer want the app to start at sign-in, then
remove the bundle:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-desktop-autostart-win
```

Removing the bundle deletes the routes and the page. It does not clear the
startup entry.

dsh-desktop-autostart-win README · Development：The package is plain ESM JavaScript with no build step and no runtime
dependencies. Run the unit tests with:

```sh
npm test
```

The tests cover the registry-output parser, encoding fallback, path cleanup,
approval record decoding, and the executable-name filter. They do not touch the
real registry.

dsh-desktop-autostart-win README · Compatibility：- DSH `>=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0` (declared in `engines.dsh`; DSH refuses versions
  outside the range before installing)
- Windows 10/11 (`dsh.bundle.platforms` is `["win32"]`, so other systems are
  rejected instead of showing a dead switch)
- Node.js 22+ (the runtime bundled with DSH)

dsh-desktop-autostart-win README · Plugin index：This repository also publishes a format-1 plugin index, so the package can be
discovered from the built-in **Discover** tab:

- jsDelivr (recommended; works on networks where `raw.githubusercontent.com`
  is blocked): `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/nanwu98/dsh-desktop-autostart-win@main/index.json`
- raw GitHub: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nanwu98/dsh-desktop-autostart-win/main/index.json`

dsh-desktop-autostart-win README · Plugin index：Add it under **插件 → 发现 → 索引源 → 添加索引源**. The Discover tab needs the
experimental `plugin-market` bundle enabled in this DSH release.

dsh-desktop-autostart-win README · License：MIT. This package is independent of other plugins with a similar name; it
manages the per-user `Run` key rather than the Startup folder.
